rules.title: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.requirement: It is unlawful for rental property owners or coordinators to use algorithmic devices or software to coordinate or set rental prices, material lease terms, or occupancy levels in a way that restricts competition or facilitates parallel pricing coordination.
rules.summary_plain: In New Jersey, it is illegal for landlords or software companies to use algorithms to coordinate rent prices or lease terms to restrict competition or raise rents unfairly.
rules.summary_plain_es: En Nueva Jersey, es ilegal que los propietarios o empresas de software usen algoritmos para coordinar precios de alquiler o términos de arrendamiento que restrinjan la competencia o aumenten los alquileres injustamente.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to all rental property owners and coordinators using algorithmic devices to set or recommend rental prices or lease terms.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to government entities setting or limiting rents through affordability controls in accordance with law.
rules.quoted_span: It shall be unlawful and a violation of the “New Jersey Antitrust Act,” P.L.1970, c.73 (C.56:9-1 et seq.) for: a rental property owner, or any agent, representative, or subcontractor thereof, to receive, subscribe to, contract for, or otherwise exchange any form of consideration in return for the use of, the services of a coordinator; a coordinator to facilitate a tacit or express agreement among rental property owners that restricts competition with respect to residential dwelling units, including by performing a coordinating function; two or more persons to engage in or otherwise facilitate parallel pricing coordination; any agent or representative of a coordinator or subcontractor thereof to engage in parallel pricing coordination; or any person to perform a coordinating function.
rules.preempts_note: Municipalities are prohibited from enacting ordinances that conflict with this act.
